_comment: Example LOCAL / project configuration for the Chaos MCP server over stdio.
Cursor only auto-loads `.cursor/mcp.json`, which is now git-IGNORED so a real
key can never be committed. Copy this file to `.cursor/mcp.json` and fill in
your own SCOPED scheduler API key for local development.
IMPORTANT — the managed integration does NOT store a key here. When the
Chaos Scheduler app provisions the managed integration, the scheduler API key
is stored in the macOS Keychain (service 'chaos-scheduler-managed-mcp',
account 'managed-mcp-api-key') and the managed `command` becomes an app-owned
launcher script (`<app_data_dir>/mcp/launch-managed.sh`) that resolves the key
from the Keychain at spawn time. The real key is NEVER written into this file
(see SECURITY.md 'MCP config and Git history' and docs/adr/0010-keychain-managed-mcp-key.md).
For manual local dev only: put your own scoped key in the UNTRACKED
